title: Coefficient reduction of supported pro-etale Tate arrows
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $m\geq1$. Put $A_m=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ and use the original finite pro-etale Tate sheaf $A_{m,T}(1)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], in the fixed-scalar presentation of [def-amb-finite-tate-site-comparison-data]. Use the ordinary unbounded pro-etale derived category [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the constant module [def-pur-proetale-constant-module-unit], and direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define a supported arrow family to assign, for every such $m$, scheme $T$ with $\ell$ invertible and effective Cartier immersion $i:D\hookrightarrow T$ [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle], a class $c_{m,i}\in\operatorname{Ext}^2(i_*A_{m,D},A_{m,T}(1))$. For every $b\geq a\geq1$, let $\phi:A_b\to A_a$ be the actual quotient factor of powers of the uniformizer ideal. Define coefficient-reduction compatibility to mean that there are maps $\eta:i_*A_{b,D}\to\operatorname{Res}_\phi(i_*A_{a,D})$ and $\theta:A_{b,T}(1)\to\operatorname{Res}_\phi(A_{a,T}(1))$. On every pro-etale object they send a constant supported section $z$ to $\phi(z)$ and a pure root-limit tensor $x\otimes z$ to $x\otimes\phi(z)$. Both maps are derived scalar-extension units: for either map $F\to\operatorname{Res}_\phi G$ and every unbounded $K\in D(T,A_a)$, precomposition with the map induces a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(G,K)\to\operatorname{Hom}(F,R\operatorname{Res}_\phi K)$, using the canonical degree-zero/exact-functor comparison. Finally the Ext equation is $\eta\,\operatorname{Res}_\phi(c_{a,i})=c_{b,i}\,\theta$. This is a compatibility predicate and asserts neither existence of a family nor flatness of the quotient coefficient map. The derived tensor convention is [def-kun-derived-tensor].
